# Catalogue redesign — integrated draft

> **Not M1 acceptance.** Public-A evidence remains incomplete, public-B is blocked, and the fresh independent review is pending.

This view is a projection of the nine-judgement assessments at [assessments.json](assessments.json), bound to root source revision `f465e9bcbedb615d14f4d58873eff771aca7f357`. Every project occurs once. Project judgements and linked contribution judgements have separate homes within each project record; no aggregate or tie-break is used.

The older 0–4 records at `../catalogue/` remain disputed legacy evidence and are not current replacement scores. Bounded public evidence: [public-A, incomplete](../catalogue-redesign-public-calibration.md) · [public-B, blocked](../catalogue-redesign-public-other.md).

Coverage: **73 of 73 root-pinned projects**. Feasibility remains unknown unless a justified constrained probability range exists.

## Producer and limits

Run `python3 scripts/catalogue_redesign.py --check` to validate coverage, contract shape, source pins, evidence references, contribution links, and generated-view freshness. Run `python3 scripts/catalogue_redesign.py --render` after changing `assessments.json`. `--self-test` exercises safe negative controls. The optional filtered application was not generated because this searchable index and detail tables expose the same sources without requiring a separate interface. The view does not claim source code execution, visual/runtime verification, public-source completeness, or independent acceptance.
